title: r1 major SA: state phase-gate constraint unsatisfiable past 2b entry — single most-recent slot vs 'or later'
description: Evidence: state-schema.md:36 requires 'phase-2b or later' states to carry the red-gate fail in last_gate_result, but line 25 defines it as the single most-recent gate run — overwritten the moment the green gate runs; mdatron's family would reject every legitimate late-phase state. Contract line 36 is narrower (a state claiming 2b) and locates gate history in artifact AND tracker. Disposition: re-scope to 2b entry (data-side) or add per-layer gate history (state-format change — SO confirm). Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21, round-1 triage): re-scope to the 2b entry. Rejected: widening last_gate_result into a history list (state-format growth serving one check with a natural home elsewhere). Data-side text fix at the round-1 fix pass; no state-format change.
